notes: Characterization centers on the two-wire CMOS bus (timing, levels), the MIPI framing (SSC, Bus Park, per-frame parity), SPMI arbitration and power-state behavior, and RFFE trigger timing and command coverage.
ic_name: MIPI SPMI v2.0 + RFFE v3.0 (System Power Management + RF Front-End Control)

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Bus timing
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify SCLK frequency range (<=26 MHz SPMI / RFFE v1-v2; <=52 MHz RFFE v3.0), setup/hold, and SSC / Bus Park timing.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Signal levels
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm CMOS push-pull SCLK/SDATA levels and idle-low state.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Parity integrity
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Inject bit errors and confirm the odd-parity check ignores the faulty frame.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: SPMI arbitration
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify priority/MASTER_ID resolution, slave Request, and Transfer Bus Ownership.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: RFFE triggers
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify simultaneous multi-slave application on a Trigger event and PM-trigger timing.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Command coverage
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Exercise the SPMI and RFFE command sets including Register 0 Write, Extended/Long, Masked/Mapped writes, and DDB/ID reads.
